description: Who else may open the app's PRE (its private test version at <slug or id>.neblla.app/pre/). The developer always can. Two ways in: Neblla accounts by email (they sign in on the pre page), and links with a password for people without an account. Either can have an expiry. Once in, a person keeps a pass for 4 hours even if they sign out, so they can play as a guest; removing someone stops new passes, not one already given. Actions: "add" (email, expiresAt?) — let an account in, or change its expiry; "remove" (email); "link" (password?, expiresAt?, label?) — a new link; without a password one is generated. The password is returned once and Neblla does not store it;  "revoke" (linkId); "renewLocalKey" — a new local key, the old one stops working. Each action returns the current list. The actions that only look (list) are in neblla_pre_access_read.

email.description: For "add" and "remove": the Neblla account's email

expiresAt.description: For "add" and "link": ISO date after which it no longer opens pre (omit for no expiry)

label.description: For "link": a name for it, such as who it was sent to

password.description: For "link": 6 to 128 characters; omit to get a generated one
